## Overview

This Issuing-path reference (last modified and captured 2026-09-15) says Adyen assigned brand-specific Industry Codes (ICs) to represent unique Merchant Category Codes (MCCs) for certain brands. It directs selection of the IC that best fits the user's brand and business activity. This is classification guidance, not an onboarding approval, verified capability, issued-card state or actual brand-to-code mapping. [[adyen]] [[adyen-issuing]]

## Key takeaways

- The page conditionally directs the reader to their Adyen contact or Support **if approval for an industry code is needed before onboarding users**. It does not state that every code needs approval or provide an approval decision or process outcome. See raw lines 19-21.
- It says only certain brand-specific IC values are accepted, but the pinned raw body contains no values or table after that sentence; it moves straight to **See also**. This capture cannot supply a specific accepted code, brand mapping, MCC assignment or eligibility decision. See raw lines 23-29.
- The **See also** link points to a separate general industry-codes list. That link is navigation, not evidence for brand-specific values in this captured page. See raw lines 27-29.

- Raw lines 15-19: title, brand/business-activity selection and brand-specific IC to MCC explanation.
- Raw lines 21-23: conditional contact instruction and accepted-values statement.
